title: 1912 Prairie's front door now stands in a deep stone arch
items: The Moulton house at 1912 Prairie now has its front door set back in a deep round arch, with a moulded stone ring and a keystone, as its photograph and the 1883 engraving show. A pair of panelled doors stands under a fan-shaped window in the arch.
The pair of tall windows on the ground floor of the south gable now has round tops, as all three pictures of the house show.
Still to come: the single arch over that pair, the carved capitals beside the door, and the stone dormers and carving on the roof.
